sn34.9:1.4: jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī ca. tatra
sn34.9:1.5: bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī ca. ayaṃ imesaṃ
sn34.9:1.6: catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro
sn34.9:1.7: ca. seyyathāpi bhikkhave gavā khīraṃ …pe… pavaro cāti. sāvatthī. cattārome bhikkhave
sn34.9:1.8: jhāyī. katame cattāro. idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī. idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī hoti na samādhismiṃ
